items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: See, I used to double bass, violin, and the horn, see, on the boat. With Pichon bands.

ctx.x: Did you ever play that for dance jobs?
Yeah, I played it on the boat. I worked it on the boat with that. See, I used to double bass, violin, and the horn, see, on the boat. With Pichon bands. Yeah.

Mm-hmm. Do you think the music in New Orleans changed over the years? I mean, you've talked about how it's changed recently. Yeah, yeah. You know. Mm-hmm. But do you think the style itself has changed at all?
